name: Jarvix
author: Rich Pickering
description: Voice-native computer interaction: a bar icon showing what Jarvix is doing, the conversation window a click away, and the listening/transcript/response overlay for the Jarvix daemon.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: what Jarvix is doing right now, a click to open the conversation, and the actions worth reaching for without speaking.
